See also: Aeroporto

Galician

[edit]
Galician Wikipedia has an article on:
aeroporto
Wikipedia gl

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /aɛɾɔˈpoɾtʊ/

Noun

[edit]

aeroporto m (plural aeroportos)

  1. airport
    O avión chegará ás nove ao aeroporto internacional de Lavacolla.
    The plane will arrive at nine at the Lavacolla International Airport.

References

[edit]
  • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, editor (2006–2013), “aeroporto”, in Dicionario de Dicionarios da lingua galega [Dictionary of Dictionaries of the Galician language] (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
  • “aeroporto”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026
  • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, Ernesto Xosé González Seoane, María Álvarez de la Granja, editors (2003–2018), “aeroporto”, in Tesouro informatizado da lingua galega (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega

Etymology

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

aeroporto m (plural aeroporti)

  1. airport, airfield

Portuguese

[edit]
Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
aeroporto
Wikipedia pt

Etymology

[edit]

From aero- +‎ porto.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoʁ.tu/ [aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoh.tu]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoʁ.tu/ [aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoh.tu]
    • (São Paulo) IPA(key): /aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoɾ.tu/
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoʁ.tu/ [aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoχ.tu]
    • (Caipira) IPA(key): /aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoɻ.tu/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoʁ.to/ [aˌɛ.ɾoˈpoh.to]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɐˌɛ.ɾɔˈpoɾ.tu/

  • Rhymes: (Portugal, São Paulo) -oɾtu, (Brazil) -oʁtu
  • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: a‧e‧ro‧por‧to
  • Homophone: Aeroporto

Noun

[edit]

aeroporto m (plural aeroportos, metaphonic)

  1. airport (a place designated for airplanes)
